summary: Single-engine Cessna P210 crashed in field ~3 mi north of Hwy 96 northeast of Sheridan Lake; pilot John Lee Stubblefield (64) died; passenger (wife) injured; wreckage located after multi-agency air/ground search
location: Field ~3 mi north of Hwy 96, northeast of Sheridan Lake
responding_agency: Kiowa County Sheriff's Office; Kiowa Fire Department; Colorado State Patrol; Civil Air Patrol; Colorado Army National Guard
notes: Pilot killed; passenger injured and life-flighted to Colorado Springs. Official sheriff news release.
